budgets.module.name: Budgets
budgets.module.description: Plans what each production, department and season may spend, approved by someone other than who wrote them, with what has been spent read from the ledger.
budgets.abilities.budget.view.label: See budgets, their lines and figures
budgets.abilities.budget.manage.label: Create budgets, edit drafts and propose them
budgets.abilities.budget.approve.label: Approve, revise, close and reopen budgets
budgets.abilities.category.manage.label: Edit spending categories and their accounts
budgets.navigation.budgets.label: Budgets
budgets.navigation.categories.label: Spending categories
budgets.screens.list.empty: No budgets for this year yet
budgets.screens.list.empty-help: A budget plans what a production, a department or a season may spend. Once approved, spending is counted against it.
budgets.screens.new.title: New budget
budgets.screens.new.help: It starts as a draft. Add its lines, then propose it for approval.
budgets.screens.new.production-help: Productions that already have an open budget are not listed.
budgets.screens.new.name: Name
budgets.screens.new.name-help: Left empty, it takes the name of what it is for.
budgets.screens.new.parent-help: A line of a larger budget, such as a season's line for productions. Once approved, this budget's total counts as committed on it.
budgets.screens.budget.own-proposal: You proposed this budget, so someone else approves it.
budgets.screens.budget.income-help: What the budget expects to take, beside what the ledger shows has come in.
budgets.screens.budget.funds-help: Each approved one counts as committed on the line it is funded from.
budgets.screens.line.name: Name
budgets.screens.line.name-help-expense: What the money is for, such as Set build.
budgets.screens.line.name-help-income: Where money comes from, such as Ticket sales.
budgets.screens.line.category-help: Decides which ledger account the spending is posted to.
budgets.screens.line.sources-help: The ledger accounts whose takings count towards this line. For a production's budget, only that production's.
budgets.screens.line.reason-help: The budget is approved, so a new line is approved at once and needs a reason.
budgets.screens.revise.title: Revise amount
budgets.screens.revise.help: {name} keeps its earlier amount in its history.
budgets.screens.revise.confirm: Set it anyway, below the {amount} already spent and committed
budgets.screens.send-back.title: Send back to the author
budgets.screens.send-back.help: The budget becomes a draft again, with your note at the top.
budgets.screens.reopen.title: Reopen budget
budgets.screens.reopen.help: Say why, such as a late bill. It is approved again with its amounts as they were.
budgets.screens.categories.help: What money is spent on. Each category's spending posts to its expense account in the ledger.
budgets.screens.categories.name: Name
budgets.screens.categories.account-help: An expense account given to Budgets in the ledger's accounts.
budgets.abilities.budget.hold.label: Hold a budget
budgets.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change budget settings
budgets.settings.close.after.label: Offer to close after
budgets.settings.close.after.help: After a production's last performance, how long before its budget is offered for closing.
budgets.record-tabs.production.label: Budget
budgets.screens.production.none-help: A budget plans what the production will spend and take, and shows what it has spent so far.
budgets.screens.close.due-help: The production's last performance was a while ago. Close the budget once its last bills and claims are in.
budgets.screens.holders.title: Holders
budgets.screens.holders.help: They approve spending on this budget's lines, within budget.
budgets.screens.holders.person-help: They are given the Budget holder role on this budget only, until the role's usual end.
budgets.settings.requests.lapse-after.he: An approved request that nothing has been spent against stops counting as committed after this long.
budgets.settings.retention.requests.help: After this, a decided request keeps its amount and line but loses who asked and what for.
budgets.abilities.request.make.label: Ask to spend
budgets.abilities.claim.approve-any.labe: Approve any spending, including over budget
budgets.navigation.approvals.label: Approvals
budgets.navigation.expenses.label: Expenses
budgets.screens.requests.ask-help: Ask before you spend. Whoever holds the budget decides, and you are told.
budgets.screens.requests.line-help: A line of an approved budget.
budgets.screens.requests.description-hel: Such as "Black paint and brushes for the flats".
budgets.screens.requests.page-help: Your requests to spend, with where each has got to.
budgets.screens.requests.none-help: Ask to spend before you buy something for a show or a department.
budgets.screens.requests.no-lines: There is no approved budget to ask against yet.
budgets.screens.approvals.help: Requests to spend on the budgets you hold, oldest first.
budgets.screens.approvals.note-help: The person who asked reads this.
